description: This file defines a function to decorate a command object with various CLI options for a Playwright-based server, including configuration, extension, and browser options, and handles starting the server backend. It also includes a utility to check for ffmpeg installation.

methods.name: decorateCommand
methods.description: Adds CLI options to a command object for configuring a Playwright server, and sets up server start logic based on options.

methods.name: checkFfmpeg
methods.description: Checks if ffmpeg is installed and accessible.
